editorial.description: Set in the natural beauty of the Rincón de la Vieja countryside in Guanacaste, Borinquen Thermal Resort combines hot springs, a thermal spa, and villas and bungalows surrounded by nature. Established in 1999, it offers wellness, adventure, and multiple dining venues in a secluded North Pacific setting.

faq.a: Borinquen Thermal Resort is located in Rincón de la Vieja, Guanacaste, in the North Pacific region of Costa Rica.

faq.q: Does the resort have hot springs and a spa?
faq.a: The resort features natural hot springs and the Anáhuac Wellness Thermal & Spa, offering spa treatments focused on relaxation and rejuvenation.

faq.q: What types of rooms are available?
faq.a: Accommodations include Villas, Standard Bungalows, Superior Bungalows, and Junior Suites, ranging from nature retreats to romantic couples' options.
